script.full_narration: Most people think Why AI Agents Are Different From Chatbots is just another passing tech trend. But what's happening right now isn't an upgrade — it's a complete rewrite of how we build software. If you've been watching the tech landscape over the past few months, one thing is unmistakable: the tools we rely on are fundamentally transforming. For years, developers were stuck writing repetitive boilerplate and manually stitching disparate services together. The promise of automation always seemed slightly out of reach. That brings us to Why AI Agents Are Different From Chatbots. Instead of treating systems as passive prompt-and-response utilities, we are now building proactive, multi-step agent pipelines that reason, validate, and execute autonomously. Let's look at real-world benchmarks. When you implement a structured state machine with verification gates, error recovery rates improve dramatically compared to single-shot generative models. The key insight here is simple: autonomy requires structured state, continuous feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop oversight before irreversible actions.
